mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_id, user_pw, user_name, user_addr, user_email, user_phone, user_birth, user_gender, user_alert, terms_agreed, location_agreed, role ) VALUES ( #{user.userId}, #{user.password}, #{user.name}, #{user.addr}, #{user.email}, #{user.phone}, #{user.birth}, #{user.gender}, #{user.userAlert}, #{user.termsAgreed}, #{user.locationAgreed}, 'USER' )
mapper.select: SELECT userName, password, role, email, token_expiry_date FROM user WHERE reset_token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_login (userId, refreshToken, expiryDate) VALUES (#{userId}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiryDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE refreshToken = #{refreshToken}, expiryDate = #{expiryDate}
